faq.headline: Construction Website FAQs
faq.description: Clear answers to help you plan and publish your construction site.

items.question: Can visitors get an instant estimate?
items.answer: A form can collect project details for your team to review. Velozy does not calculate construction estimates.

items.question: Can I show projects without naming clients?
items.answer: Yes. Use photos and descriptions you are allowed to publish, and omit private details.

items.question: Can I list several service areas?
items.answer: Yes. Add the areas you actually serve in clear page copy.

items.question: What should I include in a quote request?
items.answer: Ask for the project type, location, expected timeline, and contact details. Your team can review the scope and follow up; the form does not calculate an estimate.

items.question: Can I show before-and-after project photos?
items.answer: Yes. Use photos you have permission to publish and include useful context such as the work completed and general location without exposing private client details.

items.question: Can I list the trades and areas I serve?
items.answer: Yes. Describe the work you take on and name only the service areas where your business operates.
